label: operational record, not authority
purpose: Byte-exact copies of the orchestrator-side runner/gate scripts and logs used in the MS18d C2 campaign (SA1 Phase D condition B2). Authority stays with the committed C log, run folders, base records and rulings.

files.name: gp-results.jsonl
files.role: runner attempt log: one line per runner-launched attempt (chunks 1-114 and the three a3s); code = runner exit, line = recorder result line; no gate waits or exit-6 gate pauses

files.role: saved pre-launch check output (-ChecksOnly) for mega16-easy a3, 07:15

files.role: saved full output of the butterfly-master a3 run (pre-checks, gate, attempt 3)
